# hpe_morpheus_network_pool_server_type (Data Source)



## Example Usage

```terraform
data "hpe_morpheus_network_pool_server_type" "example" {
  id = 3
}
```

```terraform
data "hpe_morpheus_network_pool_server_type" "example" {
  name = "Infoblox"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `id` (Number) The ID of the network pool server type
- `name` (String) The name of the network pool server type

### Read-Only

- `code` (String) The code identifier of the network pool server type
- `description` (String) A description of the network pool server type
- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether this network pool server type is enabled
- `integration_code` (String) The integration code associated with the network pool server type
- `pool_service` (String) The pool service backing this network pool server type
- `selectable` (Boolean) Whether this network pool server type can be selected
